src2=src.replace("if g[r][c]!=bg: lines.setdefault","if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=0: lines.setdefault")
ns={}
exec(src2,ns)
transform=ns['transform']
ok=all(transform(p['input'])==p['output'] for p in prs)
print('all pairs ok:',ok)
test=[[5]*12 for _ in range(25)]+[[5]*8+[2]+[5]*3,[5]*6+[0,2]+[5]*4,[5]*6+[2,0]+[5]*4]
out=transform(test)
diff=[(r,c,out[r][c]) for r in range(28) for c in range(12) if out[r][c]!=test[r][c]]
print(diff)
if ok:
    open(f'{base}/{tid}.py','w').write(src2)
    json.dump({'task':tid,'files':[f'{base}/{tid}.py',f'{base}/{tid}.json'],
               'rule':'Extend contiguous same-color runs (length>=2, color != 0) along their diagonal/antidiagonal in both directions until blocked; 0 never extends.',
               'program_reproduces_all_pairs':True,'pairs':prs},open(f'{base}/{tid}.json','w'))
    print('saved')
print(json.dumps(out))
